## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and any limitations. For rendering or device changes, use a synthetic reproduction and state the model/firmware tested.

- [ ] No private notebooks, PDFs, device serials, credentials, or personal paths included.
- [ ] Tablet access remains read-only; archive/recovery behavior is preserved.
- [ ] User-facing changes and compatibility limits are documented.
